_help: Provenance patterns. Each one says how a user-entered value is recorded in the graph, and how to read it back.
Add your own by copying an entry and giving it a new id. No code changes are needed; restart the app to load it.
Variables available in 'write' (a SPARQL INSERT template, one solution per user-entered value):
?subject   the individual        ?property  the attribute        ?value  the value
?user      who entered it (text) ?userIri   an IRI built from ?user (data namespace + 'user_' + id)
?time      when (xsd:dateTime)   ?flag      the user-edited property from settings    ?class  the individual's class
A variable with no value (e.g. no user given) simply leaves out the triples that use it.
'read' is a SPARQL graph pattern that must bind ?subject and ?property, and may bind ?user and ?time.
'declarations' is Turtle added once to the output, for terms the ontology doesn't already declare.
The ':' prefix always means the ontology namespace; rdf, rdfs, owl, xsd and every ontology prefix are available.

presets.name: OWL axiom, user as text
presets.description: Flags the field with :userEdited and records who (plain text) and when on an owl:Axiom attached to that statement. The default.

presets.name: OWL axiom, user as individual
presets.description: Like the default, but each user becomes a :User individual with a :userId, and :editedBy points to it.
presets.declarations:
:editedBy a owl:AnnotationProperty ; rdfs:label "edited by"@en .
:editedAt a owl:AnnotationProperty ; rdfs:label "edited at"@en ; rdfs:range xsd:dateTime .
:User a owl:Class ; rdfs:label "User"@en .
:userId a owl:DatatypeProperty ; rdfs:domain :User ; rdfs:range xsd:string .

presets.name: Flag only
presets.description: Only records which fields were user-entered (:userEdited), without who or when.

presets.name: RDF reification
presets.description: Describes each user-entered statement with an rdf:Statement node carrying who and when. No :userEdited flag.
presets.declarations:
:editedBy a owl:AnnotationProperty ; rdfs:label "edited by"@en ; rdfs:range xsd:string .
:editedAt a owl:AnnotationProperty ; rdfs:label "edited at"@en ; rdfs:range xsd:dateTime .
